descriptionMarkdown:
Investigator; Gain expertise in Investigation or Insight. As a bonus action, study one creature, device, or scene you can see within 60 ft; until the end of your next turn, it counts as studied for your Investigator features. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.

Investigator; When you hit a creature you have studied or identified, add your Wisdom modifier to the damage once per turn.

Investigator; Once per short rest, ask the GM one tactical question about a creature, device, crime scene, or battlefield; the GM answers truthfully but briefly.

Investigator; When you ask a tactical question, you may also learn one useful weakness, route, or leverage point.
